description.narrative: The main expected project-level outcomes stem from (i) environmental effects by establishing 70MW RE capacity in Indonesia where electricity generation is a major contributor to overall greenhouse gas emissions, and (ii) stakeholder effects by increasing the supply of electricity in the South Kalimantan province, with a tariff significantly lower than PLNs cost of generation in the region. Beyond the Project, the investment is expected to improve the resilience of the power sector supporting the third grid scale and competitively tendered wind IPP in the country, expected to yield significant demonstration effects and diversify the countrys energy mix, while also demonstrating the commercial viability of novel technologies to fuel Indonesias energy transition.

The project involves the development, construction, operation and maintenance of a greenfield 70 megawatt (MW) wind power plant with 10 megawatt hours (MWh) battery energy storage system (BESS) located in Tanah Laut Regency, South Kalimantan Province, Indonesia (the Project). PT Tala Alam Baru will undertake the Project under a 25-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara (Persero) (PLN), Indonesias state electricity company.
